name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

sources.excerpt: Quoted from the Steam store page Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（EA CANADA 与 EA Romania）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 712），首页没有专门讨论该披露的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 5 次、登记 11 条去重结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（GameDB.ai 条目，只是对商店披露的转录）；ResetEra 汇总帖两次检索均返回 HTTP 403，未能读取正文。披露本身为“可能使用”且未指明范围，八个领域全部按未说明处理，不做推测。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-30 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A football simulation. The Steam disclosure only says generative AI may have been used for pre-rendered or live-generated content and that such content comes from a human-led creative process, naming no assets or areas, so the scope is unspecified.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (EA CANADA and EA Romania) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 712); no homepage thread is dedicated to the disclosure and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched five times with 11 deduplicated results logged and one raw source read (GameDB.ai, a transcription of the store disclosure); a ResetEra summary thread returned HTTP 403 on both attempts and could not be read. Because the disclosure itself says "may have been used" without naming any scope, all eight areas are recorded as not stated rather than guessed. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
